name: clioquinol + hydrocortisone
uses: Uses ICHYBUM is a medicated cream used to help relieve the symptoms of pruritis ani and other afflictions involving chronic itching around the anus
otcwarn: Warnings FOR EXTERNAL USE ONLY Ask a doctor before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you are under 12 years of age, you have an infection affecting the anus or surrounding area e.e. a sexually transmitted disease, or tuberculosis Stop use and consult a doctor if condition worsens or does not improve after regular use as directed
